items.title: Pay outstanding rent arrears and utility cost balance
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie, den Rückstand bis 7. Dezember 2026 zu überweisen.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment: 7 December 2026. This is a Monday, not a weekend day or a NW public holiday, so no shift under §193 BGB is needed. The due date as written is the last day the transfer must be made; to actually arrive by then, sending a few business days earlier is advisable, but the stated deadline itself is 2026-12-07.

warnings: This is a friendly payment request from a private landlord/property manager, not an authority letter, so there is no statutory 'deemed delivery' period or formal legal remedy (Rechtsbehelf) attached to it; it is simply a request with a stated due date.

The IBAN given (DE56 3705 0198 0005 5933 00) is well-formed and German, but a valid IBAN does not prove ownership — compare it against earlier rent statements or the management company's known bank details before paying, especially since rent-arrears letters are a common phishing target.
